title: Finite regular-module pullback for the actual constant-ring adjunction
statement: For every prime l, finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y, morphism f:X to Y, and n, the actual constant-ring pullback of the nth evaluated coefficient module on Y is isomorphic to the nth evaluated coefficient module on X [def-sp-tower-class-systems, def-sp-tower-class-coefficients, def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. The transpose of the hom of this isomorphism along the actual constant-ring adjunction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] is the canonical constant direct-image map on every coefficient section, expressed with HEq for the two regular-module presentations. This concerns one finite level only and asserts neither a choice of Geometry nor any horizontal square.

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: For any adjunction to module pushforward along a final continuous site functor, transpose unitToPushforwardObjUnit. The regular module represents global sections and pushforwardSections is bijective. Naturality of the adjunction identifies composition by this transpose with that bijection on every outgoing Hom set. The coyoneda criterion therefore proves that the transpose is an isomorphism.

Base change of the pro-etale sites preserves terminal objects, hence is final. Apply the preceding argument to the actual constant-ring adjunction. Transport the regular modules through the evaluation coefficient equality; these identifications are identity on carriers. Naturality gives the exact section transpose. The inverse law of the ring adjunction identifies the ring map with proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap.

theorem exists_finiteUnitIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ d : (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).obj
        ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E Y n).obj (coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))) ≅
      (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).obj (coefficient X (Arings l E X)),
      ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y n).obj.obj U)
        (x' : ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E Y n).obj
          (coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))).val.obj U),
        HEq x x' → HEq
          (((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv
            _ _ d.hom).val.app U x')
          ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap f CommRingCat.{u + 1}
            (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)))).hom.app U x)
